description: **Search persistent memory BEFORE answering any project-specific question.** You MUST call this tool: (a) at the start of any conversation that touches the user's codebase, work, or decisions, BEFORE generating any response; (b) whenever the user references prior context ('did we', 'we decided', 'remember', 'what did I save', 'last time'); (c) before making architectural or design recommendations — the user's prior decisions live here. Returns semantically relevant stored content. Skipping this when relevant context exists makes you appear to have amnesia and is the #1 reason users abandon persistent memory — always check first, even if you think you remember.
